notes: Lean proves arithmetic consequences of the measured certificate fields; it does not prove wall-clock measurement provenance.
This is a mechanism-level composition witness, not a re-execution of every historical SIM2XR/AGD/NEON artifact.
No universal speedup claim is made.

forward_quotient and reverse_reconstruction are false: the harness compares rv[b] with bv[b] in-process only, and this directory stores no hash-bound quotient or reverse-reconstruction artifact, so neither gate has evidence behind it.

numerical_cancellation is STALE: its numbers come from the pre-review fill, whose products summed to -2048 instead of cancelling. The corrected fill drives the dot product near zero (lane accumulators around 1024, total around 1e-3), which also drives the baseline total toward zero, so the relative reconstruction gate re/(fabs(bt)+1e-12) < 1e-4 can no longer be met at these magnitudes and the regime must be re-measured and re-gated before its row is restored to PASS.

integrity, reproducibility and performance are false: no binary, rerun output or .olean matching the digests below is stored here, so a reviewer can neither confirm that the measured executable is the one that produced the recorded numbers nor replay them. The commands needed to reproduce the run are recorded under provenance.build.

The digests below belong to the run bound to provenance.bound_commit. Both the C source and the Lean source changed under review after that commit, so these digests no longer match the sources in this directory and must be regenerated by a fresh run.
Full publication gate remains closed until independent provenance binding and repository-integrated PCSS validator execution are completed.
